import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int[][] data = new int[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                data[i][j] = scanner.nextInt();
            }
        }
        long totalProb = 0;
        int maxMask = 1 << n;
        for (int subsetMask = 1; subsetMask < maxMask; subsetMask++) {
            long probProduct = 1;
            for (int rowIdx = 0; rowIdx < n; rowIdx++) {
                if (((subsetMask >> rowIdx) & 1) == 1) {
                    probProduct *= data[0][rowIdx];
                } else {
                    probProduct *= (100 - data[0][rowIdx]);
                }
            }
            totalProb += probProduct;
        }
        System.out.println(totalProb);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
